status: development-only causal competence experiment on one already-open released PhysTwin case
claim_boundary: This protocol can test whether a new BayesianPhysTwin causal absolute graph-part field has enough prefix-only predictive competence to justify a larger frozen source panel. It is not the published MatPhys method, is not independent or confirmatory, and cannot establish a state-of-the-art claim.

case.selection: canonical already-open single-lift case not used by the preceding all-frame sloth capacity control

method.video_frame_contract: 16 uniform numeric filename IDs strictly before frame 34
method.initialization: fresh generic VideoMAE initialization; no benchmark-trained or all-frame checkpoint

stage_0_mechanical_smoke.pass: The exact audit validates, every optimizer/checkpoint tensor is finite, at least one optimizer step is accepted, no step is rejected, the export validates, and the complete spring field is finite and positive.
stage_0_mechanical_smoke.failure: Stop and amend only a source-independent implementation defect before any 200-epoch run.

stage_1_causal_competence.authorization: Only after the stage-0 gate passes and the implementation plus this protocol are committed.
stage_1_causal_competence.prediction_seal: Checkpoint, causal audit, trajectory, spring field, and external-backbone manifest are hash-bound before released future metrics are read.
stage_1_causal_competence.evaluation: Official released PhysTwin Chamfer and frame-zero manual-identity track metrics on [46,66), compared with exact released inference.pkl under the same evaluator.
stage_1_causal_competence.competence_pass: The candidate improves both future metrics by at least 10 percent versus exact released PhysTwin, every spring is positive, at least two parts have distinct geometric-mean stiffness, and no optimizer step is rejected.
stage_1_causal_competence.sota_headroom_diagnostic: Report whether this single case is at or below 8 mm Chamfer and 15 mm track error. Passing is not a SOTA claim because the published point is cohort-level and this case is already open.
stage_1_causal_competence.advance: A competence pass authorizes a separately frozen five-case already-open source panel. A failure closes this absolute-prefix family without tuning on the case outcome.

forbidden: using RGB, depth, geometry, manual tracks, or checkpoint selection at or after frame 34 during fitting
reusing the all-frame sloth checkpoint or learned spring field
changing epochs, fit fraction, part count, feature scale, learning rate, seed, or gate after stage-1 metrics are opened
calling the adapter the published MatPhys method
calling this one-case result independent, confirmatory, calibrated, state of the art, or better than state of the art
altering the frozen Deform360 v6.1 candidate or scorer
using held-v8 runtime, target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifacts
opening any fresh target or confirmation outcome
